title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Yes, I have received the notification that fragmentation mines are forbidden in the corridors. But rest assured, Doctor, the high voltage fencing installed on your door violates no ordinances.

title: Appointed as Assistant
original: 'Calamity'. Deploying simulation sequence. Activating emergency response protocols. Queueing worst-case scenario simulation.

title: Talk 1
original: Indeed, I was the one who introduced recent Lateran Operators to Rhodes Island. If you have no objections, I will continue to introduce functionaries with special circumstances to you. I hope to study how Sankta live outside Lateran, and how it compares to their life within.

title: Talk 1
original: From the Tower of Revelations to the Notarial Hall in Pagus Michaelion, then on to the Sunset Chapel in Pagus Saint Marcel, then the chapel square—the city is alight. I sense the existence of each individual, and their disappearance as well. We are one—as 'Laterano'.

title: Talk 2
original: This mission may call for a piano performance? Do not worry. I have memorized the complete scores of over a hundred classical pieces, and I can play every note in accurate order. Any properly trained executor should be capable of this. That does not count as playing the piano? I do not understand.

title: Talk 2
original: The entity known as The Lord of Fiends is locked on, and I will help her shed the Black Crown. Civlight Eterna is too heavy a burden for a single fledgling. Laterano will share in this aura, and 'empathy' shall unite Sankta and Sarkaz as one.

title: Talk 3
original: The title 'Saint' can neither enhance my abilities nor reveal any precise mission to me. Though it has added difficulties to my work, I cannot fathom why I was chosen. Its objective and demands are something I must seek myself.

title: Talk 3
original: The Many share similarities with present-day Laterano, but extreme approach behavior does not conform to the laws of evolution. Does this mean, however, that they are no longer sentient? And can such a life form come to a natural end? The nomadic monastery has arrived on the coast; You Many, your answers shall be used as reference for the conclusion.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Doctor, this is my medical examination report, please confirm. Currently, no horns have grown on my head, and my halo has seen no changes in shape or form. Indeed, my violation of the law has not had a physical effect on me, but it's nothing worthy of celebration. Abnormalities have been on the rise. This is an omen of disaster.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Owing to 'empathy', Laterano remains pure and efficient, even in the face of 'calamity'. When night falls, this place is the first to illuminate. Laterano will reconvene the Summit of Nations, and rally all forces when necessary.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Doctor, during my recent missions, my limbs have been acting before I complete my thought processes. This phenomenon can impede successful completion of my missions. I am troubled. Could you tell me whether it's a kind of disease? Will my condition worsen? Is there a medicine that can heal it?

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: It possesses no personality yet maintains the capability to modulate and influence human emotions. Why did it ultimately choose to develop a mechanism as complex as 'empathy' for the Sankta...? What brought about such a question? I am thinking—Error, exception detected.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Most confuse Arturia's Arts as tampering with cognition and mental faculty, but I know the fact is just the opposite. Arturia is interested only in the truest emotions, and cares not for where these emotions lead. The influence she can command is far worse than anyone can possibly imagine.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Emotional fluctuation detected; the six-year-old heir to the decedent does not possess the requisite psychological resilience. Processing; she demonstrates capacity to accept the decedent's status... 'Death'. Federico, you, too, stood in the rain at that cemetery. Did you come to understand it?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: What are you doing, Doctor? Bodily contact is no replacement for spoken language. I cannot decipher your thoughts through your limbs. You think that I need comfort? If that is your judgment, then I have no reason to refuse. In fact, I am merely thinking back to my recent mission. What leaves a man no other choice, but death?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Yulia, Clément—error; above names should not appear in the list of victims... Do you still remember? Federico, when your mother taught you to read and write, to play music. She whispered to you as you slept—you would come understand that you were just as useful as any patron firearm.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: As you can see, this is a burnt flower. I have, to the best of my abilities, maintained its condition in order to bring it to you. It is not a gift, because it does not meet the criteria for one. It's a question in my mind. I am still pondering the things behind this flower.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Arturia, cease your seduction of the Doctor. I am awake. I will share the possibilities I saw, as well as the limitations within. My head is still too foggy to begin the description, please allow me a look at the sky—it is a blue most familiar to me, Doctor.

title: Idle
original: You lack sleep, Doctor. You need more rest.

title: Idle
original: Program running normally. Status: stable.

title: Onboard
original: You seem surprised, Doctor. Please rest assured that the change in my equipment won't affect my ability to complete my missions. If you find yourself ill at ease because of my attire, I can change into my previous garments before I enter Rhodes Island. No need? Understood.

title: Onboard
original: Pathway locked. Framework stable. Connection established. This is Laterano.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: I have attempted a few combat techniques, and they have yielded excellent results.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Archive complete.

title: Promotion 1
original: You put together an all new profile. Is this a false identity for my next mission? If the need arises, I know where to prepare identification that can pass checks. No need? This, too, is a normal promotion?

title: Promotion 1
original: True. Our partnership agreement requires renewal—you represent Rhodes Island, and I, Laterano.

title: Promotion 2
original: I am trying to understand the law. Is Laterano's foundation truly these words alone? Is that applicable to lands other than Laterano? I must admit I have indeed been affected by it, to a certain degree. I will attempt to find the answer posthaste.

title: Promotion 2
original: I see a certain future. Of Laterano, and of myself. The events that transpire within are far from inscrutable, but the question I find myself pondering is: why do they come to pass?

title: Added to Squad
original: The law itself has no power. It calls for enforcers.

title: Added to Squad
original: I am Laterano. I calculate every possibility, and remove every obstacle.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: I require those who can act on their own judgment.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Request received. Processing.

title: Depart
original: Move out.

title: Depart
original: In which zone did the crisis occur?

title: Begin Operation
original: Commencing operation. Please confirm the mission objective.

title: Begin Operation
original: Assessing crisis danger level…

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Understood.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Laterano has reached a conclusive assessment of the situation.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Your request is reasonable.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Emergency response protocols initializing.

title: Deployment 1
original: Prayers are unnecessary.

title: Deployment 1
original: Laterano responds.

title: Deployment 2
original: I shall ensure the integrity of the law.

title: Deployment 2
original: Laterano intervenes.

title: In Battle 1
original: Target confirmed.

title: In Battle 1
original: Fire, as the Commandments apply.

title: In Battle 2
original: Destruction is the most naive behavior.

title: In Battle 2
original: Purge, as the protocols require.

title: In Battle 3
original: Annihilation is the most common result.

title: In Battle 3
original: All principles are breakable.

title: In Battle 4
original: Violated taboos hold no power.

title: In Battle 4
original: All taboos are null.

title: 4-star Result
original: No casualties, no commotions. All good.

title: 4-star Result
original: Annihilation shall not manifest.

title: 3-star Result
original: Mission complete.

title: 3-star Result
original: Operation complete. Laterano will now return to the landship.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: The result is acceptable.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: The Commandments contain deficiencies. I will implement corrections.

title: Operation Failure
original: We need to reformulate our battle plans.

title: Operation Failure
original: Doctor, I have awoken.

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Maintaining a dedicated room is a show of respect? I see.

title: Assigned to Facility
original: All is normal.

title: Tap
original: I have heard there are certain hobbies that are not easily understood by others. Perhaps this is one such hobby?

title: Tap
original: I did not notice your presence, Doctor. I am still processing this information.

title: Trust Tap
original: Speak the word if you need anything, Doctor.

title: Trust Tap
original: Thank you, my condition is now stable.

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Changes in numbers and symbolistic objects are how man reminds himself of the flow of time. Yes, I can understand, in spite of the fact that I need no such reminders. However, if this day brings you joy, then it is indeed very meaningful. Happy New Year, Doctor.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Even under such conditions, rituals of similar types persist. Wandering executors return to the nearest monastery to spend the day with their compatriots. I sense the existence and disappearance of each individual. I recollect that feeling, and know that it is not 'empathy'.

title: Greeting
original: You have changed greatly, Doctor.

title: Greeting
original: Doctor, please hold here. These possibilities require immediate disclosure and discussion. With YOU.

title: Birthday
original: Gifts need to be packaged properly, so its contents cannot be seen on a single glance? Is this a compulsory requirement? My apologies, Doctor, I am not well-versed in such matters. I will prepare an unscannable safe and a new gift. Please give me a moment.

title: Birthday
original: I am about to return to Laterano. The Notarial Hall's directives take precedence over your birthday celebration. I have, however, acquired this party hat for you... Is this inappropriate? If my understanding is correct, blue is a suitable color for such an occasion.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: I have been looking for you, Doctor. The cleaning agreement that I have entered into with your company is nearing its end. If you desire a new agreement, you may refer to these items I brought with me for reference. The Notarial Hall has never entered into a long term agreement with a foreign corporation. Our partnership with Rhodes Island will be a new challenge.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: The possibilities that Arturia and I perceive are uniformly extreme; nevertheless, Rhodes Island, and you, as its commander, remain a constant variable. Therefore, Doctor, your assessment is required before 'calamity' arrives.
